Vulnerability Note VU#990099

AcmeDocs template engine expression injection

Overview

AcmeDocs versions 4.0.0 through 4.2.3 contain an expression injection vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2099-12345. A remote, unauthenticated attacker may be able to execute arbitrary code on the server.

Impact

An attacker who can reach a vulnerable AcmeDocs server with the preview feature enabled may execute code with the privileges of the AcmeDocs service.

Solution

Apply the update to AcmeDocs 4.2.4. Administrators who cannot update should disable the preview feature.
